pois.label: 中水处理串列（颜色就是回收率的收据）
pois.label_en: Reclaimed-water train (the colour is the receipt)
pois.detail: 从左到右四种水色：进水井里的褐、沉降池的棕黄、膜后的浅青、清水池的清蓝。地上那四条色条把这条因果链写下来，免得有人以为『中水』只是个词。串列末端的清蓝水泵回地下城，供饮用、备餐、卫生与作物复水——这座城喝的每一口水，都从这条串列里走过。
pois.detail_en: Four shades of water left to right: brown in the intake well, tawny in the settler, pale teal after the membranes, clear blue in the product basin. The four colour strips on the ground write that causal chain down, so nobody takes 'reclaimed water' for a figure of speech. From the far end the clear blue is pumped back to the undercity for drinking, cooking, hygiene and crop rehydration - every mouthful this city drinks has walked this train.

specs.进料通量: 659 kg/sol（尿+冲洗 248 / 冷凝 269 / 灰水 142）
specs.串列: 沉降（刮泥 1.2 rpm）→ MF/RO 膜撬 ×3 → UV 消毒柱 ×3

specs_en.Feed: 659 kg/sol (248 urine and flush, 269 condensate, 142 greywater)
specs_en.Train: settling with a 1.2 rpm rake, three MF/RO membrane skids, three UV columns

sim: 水账逐项配平（离场 83.0 − 入场 52.7 = 净补 30.3 L/sol）。离场：回收厂残渣 12.2、粪水随堆肥排气 2.2、固废夹带 3.2、气闸水汽 0.5、农业膜渗漏与收成外带 25、维护排放 15、fab 独立回路补水 25。入场（不用井水的水源）：代谢生成水 40.8、堆肥好氧生成水 6.8、进口食物自带水 5.1。质量守恒闸残差 0.000。
最反直觉的一项：人是净产水的。食物里的氢被氧化成水，每人每天 0.345 kg，全城 40.8 kg/sol——比整个回收厂的残渣损失还多三倍。所以真正要 Rodwell 补的，不是『人喝掉的水』，是膜渗漏、维护排放与残渣夹带这些工程漏项。
井的额度分配才是这张卡的重点：生保（含农业与 fab）30.3 L/sol 只占 380 L/sol 产能的 8%，ISRU 推进剂制氢占 50.8%。**这口井的主要客户不是人，是火箭。** res-rodwell-01 卡上那句『乘组需求 380 L/sol（4 人）』应改为『产能 380 L/sol，生保占 8%』。
sim_en: The water ledger balances item by item: 83.0 out minus 52.7 in leaves 30.3 L/sol of make-up. Out: 12.2 in plant residue, 2.2 of faecal moisture escaping with compost off-gas, 3.2 entrained in dry trash, 0.5 as airlock vapour, 25 to agricultural membrane leakage and harvest carry-out, 15 to maintenance discharge, 25 to the fab's separate loop. In, without touching the well: 40.8 of metabolic water, 6.8 generated by aerobic composting, 5.1 arriving inside imported food. Mass-balance gate residual 0.000.

The least intuitive entry: people are net water producers. Hydrogen in food oxidizes to water at 0.345 kg per person-day, 40.8 kg/sol across the city - three times the entire plant's residue loss. So what the Rodwell well actually makes up is not 'the water people drank' but membrane leakage, maintenance discharge and entrainment: engineering losses, not human ones.

The allocation of the well is this card's real point. Life support including agriculture and the fab takes 30.3 L/sol, 8% of the well's 380 L/sol; ISRU propellant hydrogen takes 50.8%. The well's principal customer is not people but rockets. The line on the res-rodwell-01 card reading 'crew demand 380 L/sol (4 crew)' should become 'capacity 380 L/sol, of which life support takes 8%'.
pois.physics: 闭环生保的品质因数是回收率，而回收率的边际价值随 1/(1−r) 发散：90% 与 98% 听起来差八个百分点，补给量却差五倍。火星上每一克水都来自钻井加热冰层（res-rodwell-01 的 Stefan 账：每 380 L 扩腔 0.41 m³），所以回收率不是环保指标，是井寿命的兑换率。
pois.physics_en: The figure of merit for closed-loop life support is recovery ratio, and its marginal value diverges as 1/(1-r): ninety versus ninety-eight percent sounds like eight points but is a fivefold difference in make-up. Every gram of water here was melted out of an ice sheet - the Rodwell Stefan ledger prices it at 0.41 m3 of cavity growth per 380 L drawn - so recovery ratio is not an environmental metric but an exchange rate on well life.

pois.label: 尿处理串列（预处理不是可选项）
pois.detail: 橙顶那只小罐是预处理罐，酸化加氧化剂；后面卧着的是蒸汽压缩蒸馏器；再后面那台带抽屉的箱子是卤水处理器，抽屉里那层白色就是全城水回路真正丢掉的东西——干盐。全城每 sol 189 kg 尿进来，98.5% 变回可饮用水，剩下 3.7 kg 变成压块里的盐。
pois.detail_en: The orange-topped vessel is the pre-treatment tank - acid plus oxidant. Behind it lies the vapour-compression still, and behind that the brine processor with its half-drawn tray; the pale layer in that tray is the only thing the city's water loop truly throws away. 189 kg of urine arrives each sol, 98.5% leaves as potable water, and 3.7 kg leaves as salt bound for a compaction brick.

specs.二段 卤水处理器: 对残余再回收 90% → 合计 98.5%
specs.干盐固化: 3.7 kg/sol（NaCl / 尿素残渣 / 磷酸钙）
specs.预处理: 酸化 + 氧化剂（防氨挥发与磷酸钙结垢）

specs_en.Feed: 189 kg of urine plus 59 kg of flush water per sol
specs_en.Solidified salt: 3.7 kg/sol - sodium chloride, urea residue, calcium phosphate
specs_en.Pre-treatment: acidification plus oxidant, against ammonia release and calcium-phosphate scaling

sim: 两段串联的杠杆：单靠 VCD 是 85%，补一台卤水处理器把残余的 90% 再抠回来，合计 98.5%。补给量从 37 kg/sol 降到 3.7 kg/sol——第二段设备买的不是水，是井寿命。
预处理为什么是硬约束：尿里的脲酶把尿素分解成氨，氨腐蚀铝件；钙磷在蒸发器壁上结垢堵管。这是 ISS 尿处理器最主要的两个故障模式，不是可选工序。橙色罐顶就是这条约束的可视标记。
干盐去哪：与固废压块合流，进 hab-tunnel-01 覆土丘。城里没有下水道，也没有排放口——最后一克离开水回路的物质，也只是换了个身份继续当屏蔽。
sim_en: The leverage of two stages in series: distillation alone gives 85%, and a brine processor clawing back 90% of the remainder gives 98.5% together. Make-up falls from 37 kg/sol to 3.7. The second machine does not buy water; it buys well life.

Why pre-treatment is a hard constraint: urease in urine converts urea to ammonia, ammonia attacks aluminium, and calcium phosphate scales the evaporator walls until the tubes block. Those are the two dominant failure modes of the ISS urine processor, not an optional refinement. The orange tank top is that constraint made visible.

Where the salt goes: into the compaction stream with the solid waste and out to the hab-tunnel-01 berm. The city has no sewer and no outfall - even the last gram to leave the water loop merely changes identity into shielding.
pois.physics: 尿是一种被生物过程刻意浓缩过的废水：肾脏把代谢废物压到最小体积，代价是让它变成对设备最不友好的液体——高盐、高尿素、高钙磷。所以尿处理器的难点从来不是把水蒸出来，是让蒸发面在几百个循环之后仍然是干净的金属。回收率的最后几个百分点，全是结垢与腐蚀的工程。
pois.physics_en: Urine is wastewater that biology has deliberately concentrated: kidneys compress metabolic waste into the smallest possible volume, at the cost of producing the least equipment-friendly liquid imaginable - high salt, high urea, high calcium and phosphate. The hard part of a urine processor was never boiling water off; it is keeping the evaporator surface clean metal after several hundred cycles. The last few points of recovery are entirely a scaling-and-corrosion problem.

pois.label: 堆肥反应器（dome-hall 那批堆肥的来源）
pois.label_en: Compost reactor (where the dome's compost finally comes from)
pois.detail: 卧式转鼓朝观察侧剖开，六片翻抛桨在转，料床分三段：进料端赭黄（作物残体+干粪+调理料）、中段深褐、出料端黑褐。res-dome-hall-01 的土层剖面卡写着『洗盐 regolith 混堆肥』——堆肥从哪来，一直没人回答。就是这里。三根接口管把它的身份说清楚：白管进氧、青管出 CO₂、蓝管出冷凝水，它不是排放口，是一台三接口设备。
pois.detail_en: The horizontal drum is cut open toward the visitor, six paddles turning inside, the bed reading in three bands: ochre at the feed end (crop residue, dried faeces, bulking agent), dark brown in the middle, near-black at the discharge. The res-dome-hall-01 soil card says the beds are 'washed regolith blended with compost' - where that compost came from had never been answered. Here. Three pipes settle its identity: white in for oxygen, teal out for CO2, blue out for condensate. Not an outfall; a three-port machine.

specs.进料: 干粪 3.8 + 不可食生物量 5.0 + 厨余 3.7 + 纤维素调理料 13.0 = 25.5 kg 干/sol
specs.C/N: 三料原值 15.6 → 掺调理料后 27.0（好氧目标 25~30）
specs.好氧: 耗 O₂ 12.1 · 放 CO₂ 16.6 · 生成水 6.8 kg/sol
specs.产出: 腐熟堆肥 14.1 kg 干/sol = 9.44 t/火星年
specs.灭菌: 55~65 °C 保持 >3 天；出料检大肠菌群与蠕虫卵

specs_en.Feed: 3.8 kg dried faeces, 5.0 inedible biomass, 3.7 kitchen scrap, 13.0 cellulosic bulking agent - 25.5 kg dry per sol
specs_en.C/N: 15.6 for the three wet streams alone, 27.0 with bulking (aerobic target 25-30)
specs_en.Aerobic duty: 12.1 kg O2 consumed, 16.6 kg CO2 released, 6.8 kg water generated per sol
specs_en.Output: 14.1 kg dry mature compost per sol, 9.44 t per Mars year
specs_en.Sanitation: 55-65 C held for over 3 days; coliform and helminth-ova testing before use

sim: 闸门抓出的真问题：粪 C/N≈8、作物残体 35、厨余 20，三料混合只有 15.6 —— 远低于好氧堆肥的 25~30。氮过剩会以氨气跑掉，在封闭舱里既臭又腐蚀铝件，还白白丢掉肥料里最贵的元素。解法是掺 13.0 kg/sol 纤维素调理料（破碎织物/纸/滤材，C/N≈90），一举三得：配平 C/N 到 27.0、给堆体开孔隙供氧、同时给织物固废找到比压块更好的去向。
扩床能力：9.44 t/火星年，按掺 10 wt%、上层 0.3 m、堆密度 1500 kg/m³ 计，每火星年可新建 **210 m² 苗床**——res-dome-hall-01 现有 320 m²，约 1.5 个火星年翻一倍。配套要洗 94 t 土/火星年，其高氯酸盐蒸残回 res-eclss-01 产氧，环又闭上一道。
自举账（回答全城最大的窟窿）：床面积涨 → 生物量涨 → 堆肥涨 → 床面积再涨。从现有 519 m² 起步，堆肥产能允许的扩床速度让种植面在 **约 16 个火星年**后达到全热量自给所需的 5175 m²（45 m²/人 × 115 人）。主粮不必永远靠地球运——但**堆肥产能就是断奶速度的上限**。
生物安全红线：医疗与实验一次性耗材、TMAH 处理水**一律不得入堆肥**（前者生物危害，后者神经毒性且无法追回）。这两股在分选线上就被分色分流。
sim_en: What the gate caught: faeces run C/N about 8, crop residue 35, kitchen scrap 20 - mixed, only 15.6, far under the 25-30 an aerobic pile wants. Surplus nitrogen leaves as ammonia, which in a sealed habitat is foul, corrodes aluminium, and throws away the most valuable element in the fertilizer. The fix is 13.0 kg/sol of cellulosic bulking agent - shredded textiles, paper and filter media at C/N about 90 - which does three jobs at once: it trims C/N to 27.0, opens porosity so oxygen reaches the core, and gives textile waste a better fate than a compaction brick.

Bed-building capacity: 9.44 t per Mars year at 10 wt% blended into a 0.3 m top layer of 1500 kg/m3 soil builds 210 m2 of new bed each Mars year. Against the dome's existing 320 m2 that is a doubling in about 1.5 Mars years. It also calls for 94 t of soil to be washed annually, whose perchlorate residue returns to res-eclss-01 as oxygen - one more loop closed.

The bootstrap, which answers the city's largest hole: more bed area means more biomass, more compost, more bed area. Starting from today's 519 m2, the expansion rate compost can sustain reaches the 5175 m2 needed for full caloric self-sufficiency (45 m2 per person, 115 people) in about 16 Mars years. Staple grain need not be shipped from Earth forever - but compost throughput is the ceiling on how fast this city can wean.

The biosafety red line: disposable medical and laboratory consumables and TMAH-treated water never enter the compost - the first is a biohazard, the second neurotoxic and unrecoverable once in the loop. Both are colour-sorted out on the picking line.
pois.physics: 好氧堆肥是一场被工程约束的燃烧：微生物用与火同样的化学（有机物+O₂→CO₂+H₂O），只是慢了几万倍，于是热量能被用来灭菌而不是烧掉碳。C/N 比是这场慢燃烧的空燃比——太富（低 C/N）氮以氨逃逸，太贫（高 C/N）分解停滞。25~30 这个窗口不是经验值，是微生物细胞自身的碳氮化学计量决定的。
pois.physics_en: Aerobic composting is combustion under engineering restraint: microbes run the same chemistry as fire - organics plus oxygen to carbon dioxide and water - some ten thousand times slower, so the heat can be spent sanitizing instead of consuming the carbon. The C/N ratio is this slow fire's air-fuel ratio: too rich in nitrogen and it escapes as ammonia, too lean and decomposition stalls. The 25-30 window is not a rule of thumb but the carbon-to-nitrogen stoichiometry of microbial cells themselves.

pois.label: 固废分选线与零填埋（垃圾变成屏蔽）
pois.label_en: Sorting line and zero landfill (rubbish becomes shielding)
pois.detail: 十四米输送带，检修天窗露出转动的带面，四只分色料仓在下游接着：黄=塑料包装、紫=织物、绿=滤材、红=医疗与实验耗材。黄仓下游那台小炉子把包装热解成 3D 打印丝材，绕在旁边三只丝盘上。剩下压不动也烧不得的，压成砖，沿地上那条橙线运去 hab-tunnel-01 的覆土丘——这座城没有垃圾场，只有屏蔽层。
pois.detail_en: A fourteen-metre belt with inspection hatches showing the moving surface, and four colour-coded bins waiting downstream: yellow for packaging plastics, purple for textiles, green for filter media, red for medical and laboratory disposables. Below the yellow bin a small pyrolysis furnace turns packaging into 3D-printing filament, wound onto the three spools beside it. What can be neither recycled nor burned is compacted into bricks and hauled along the orange line to the hab-tunnel-01 berm - this city has no landfill, only a shielding layer.

specs.塑料再生: 热解制丝材 16.2 kg/sol → ops-printer-01 与本城维修
specs.织物: 破碎后作堆肥调理料（13.0 kg/sol，见堆肥卡）
specs.压块: 93.8 kg/sol = 62.7 t/火星年 → hab-tunnel-01 覆土丘回填
specs.医疗流: 高压灭菌后压块，**不入堆肥**

specs_en.Dry solid waste: 106.3 kg/sol - 29.5 packaging, 18.9 textiles, 11.8 filter media, 10.6 medical, 35.4 miscellaneous
specs_en.Plastic recovery: 16.2 kg/sol pyrolysed to filament for ops-printer-01 and in-house repair
specs_en.Textiles: shredded as compost bulking agent, 13.0 kg/sol (see the compost card)
specs_en.Compaction: 93.8 kg/sol, 62.7 t per Mars year, backfilled into the hab-tunnel-01 berm

sim: 『零填埋』在这里有个具体含义：62.7 t/火星年的压块不是消失了，是换了身份。按压实密度 1500 kg/m³ 计入 hab-tunnel-01 丘体的遮挡质量——那张卡算过 10 m 覆土 = 1500 g/cm² 遮挡质量把 GCR 压到地球海平面量级，每一吨砖都在给这笔屏蔽账添砖。
分色不是为了整齐，是为了两条硬约束：织物必须进堆肥（C/N 调理料，见堆肥卡）、医疗耗材必须不进堆肥（生物危害）。同一条带上，颜色决定的是去向而不是外观。
口径诚实：包装塑料回收率取 55%，多层膜与铝箔复合结构剩下的 45% 无法分离，只能压块。这是 26 个月补给周期下包装设计的直接后果——包装越结实，越回不来。
sim_en: 'Zero landfill' has a concrete meaning here: 62.7 t per Mars year of bricks do not vanish, they change identity. Counted at a compacted 1500 kg/m3 into the shielding mass of the hab-tunnel-01 berm - whose own card prices 10 m of cover at 1500 g/cm2, enough to bring galactic-ray dose down to Earth sea level - every tonne of brick adds to that ledger.

The colours are not tidiness but two hard constraints: textiles must go to the compost (as C/N bulking agent) and medical disposables must not (biohazard). On one belt, colour decides destination rather than appearance.

An honest caveat on scope: packaging plastic recovery is booked at 55%; the remaining 45% is multilayer film and foil laminate that cannot be separated and can only be compacted. That is the direct consequence of designing packaging for a 26-month supply line - the tougher the wrapper, the less of it ever comes back.
pois.physics: 封闭殖民地的固废管理没有『扔掉』这个动词：任何被运上来或被造出来的原子都还在城里。所以分选的目标不是减量，是给每一股物流找到一个下游身份——燃料、调理料、骨料、屏蔽。当没有外部环境可以稀释废物时，废物管理就退化成一个纯粹的分配问题。
pois.physics_en: Solid-waste management in a closed colony has no verb for 'throw away': every atom shipped up or manufactured here is still here. Sorting therefore aims not at reduction but at giving each stream a downstream identity - feedstock, bulking agent, aggregate, shielding. With no external environment to dilute anything into, waste management degenerates into a pure allocation problem.

pois.label: 废金属打包（账上如实记为「待熔」）
pois.detail: 剪切打包机把废金属压成 0.6 m 立方块，按牌号分两垛。牌子上写着「待熔」——这两个字是本站最诚实的一处。城里还没有冶炼线，所以这些块不是产出，是库存：分选、去污、打包、登记牌号，然后等一台还不存在的炉子。把它写成『回收』是好听，写成『待熔』才是账。
pois.detail_en: The shear-baler compresses scrap into 0.6 m cubes, stacked in two piles by alloy. The sign reads 'awaiting melt' - the most honest two words on this site. The city has no smelter yet, so these bales are not output but inventory: sorted, decontaminated, baled, grade-tagged, and waiting on a furnace that does not exist. Calling it 'recycled' would sound better; calling it 'awaiting melt' is the ledger.

specs.来源: 矿场刀具 6.0 / 失效结构与管配件 5.0 / 包装钢带 3.0 / 电子废弃 2.5 / 气瓶阀泵退役 3.5
specs.去向: 暂存待熔（建议总控新开资产 ops-smelt-01）

specs_en.Sources: 6.0 mine tooling, 5.0 failed structure and fittings, 3.0 packaging strapping, 2.5 electronic waste, 3.5 retired bottles, valves and pumps
specs_en.Bale: 0.6 m cube, stacked by alloy grade
specs_en.Destination: held pending a smelter - a future asset, suggested id ops-smelt-01

sim: 13.4 t/火星年不是小数：对照 ops-depot-01 一个会合窗口 60~80 t 的天地吞吐，本城两个火星年积攒的废金属，相当于半船地球来货。冶炼线的经济性不由『减少垃圾』决定，由『不用再从地球运这些吨位』决定。
电子废弃物 2.5 kg/sol 单独分垛：板卡里的金/钯/钽在火星是真正的稀有金属，本城没有湿法提取线。要么等未来资产，要么随返程货舱回地球——两条路都要先分开存放，混进普通钢垛就再也挑不出来。
为什么现在就建打包工位而不是等冶炼线：废金属散堆占地、带尘、混牌号后价值归零。打包是把选择权留给未来的那道工序。
sim_en: 13.4 t per Mars year is not a rounding error: against the 60-80 t of Earth-Mars throughput ops-depot-01 books per launch window, two Mars years of accumulated scrap equals half a shipload of imported mass. A smelter's case will not be made by 'less rubbish' but by 'these tonnes never need shipping again'.

The 2.5 kg/sol of electronic waste is stacked separately: the gold, palladium and tantalum on those boards are genuinely scarce on Mars and this city has no hydrometallurgical line. Either a future asset recovers them or they ride a return hold back to Earth - both routes require separate storage first, because once mixed into a plain steel bale they are unrecoverable.
Why build the baling station before the smelter: loose scrap sprawls, collects dust, and loses all value once grades are mixed. Baling is the step that keeps the future's options open.
pois.physics: 行星际物流没有加急件，所以火星的物质经济更像远洋帆船时代：任何本地能再生的吨位，都直接抵扣一次发射。金属回收的价值不在环保，在轨道力学——地球到火星的每公斤都要付一次逃逸速度，而堆场里这些块的逃逸速度已经付过了。
pois.physics_en: Interplanetary logistics has no express service, so the material economy of Mars resembles the age of sail: any tonnage regenerated locally directly cancels a launch. The value of metal recovery is not environmental but orbital-mechanical - every kilogram from Earth pays an escape velocity, and the bales in this yard have already paid theirs.

pois.label: 危废中和间（三条红线，用墙表达）
pois.label_en: Hazardous-waste room (three red lines, drawn in concrete)
pois.detail: ops-fab-01 的卡上，食人鱼溶液、HF 与 CMP 浆料只有进料，没有排放去向。这间屋子就是那个去向。橙槽中和酸废、紫槽处理 HF、灰柱沉降 CMP 浆料——注意紫槽自带一道小隔墙和一根独立排风管：HF 与酸废合流会放出 HF 气体，这条红线在这里是一堵真实的墙，不是一句规程。门边那只小柜是葡萄糖酸钙急救凝胶。
pois.detail_en: On the ops-fab-01 cards, piranha solution, hydrofluoric acid and CMP slurry have inlets but no outlets. This room is the outlet. The orange bath neutralizes acid waste, the purple bath handles HF, the grey column settles CMP slurry - and note that the purple bath has its own partition wall and its own exhaust riser. Mixing HF with acid waste liberates HF gas, and here that red line is an actual wall rather than a sentence in a procedure. The small cabinet by the door holds calcium gluconate gel.

specs.酸废: 食人鱼液 30 L/sol → MnO₂ 分解 H₂O₂ → Ca(OH)₂ 中和 → 石膏 8.2 kg/sol
specs.HF: 10 L/sol → Ca(OH)₂ 沉淀 → CaF₂ 0.39 kg/sol（**独立管路独立槽**）
specs.CMP 浆料: 20 L/sol → FeCl₃ 混凝沉降 → 滤饼 1.5 kg/sol → 打印骨料
specs.TMAH 显影液: 12 L/sol → 电化学氧化至 TOC<10 mg/L（**不进城市回路**）
specs.溶剂: IPA/PGMEA 8 L/sol → 蒸馏回收 >90%，残液催化湿式氧化

specs_en.Acid waste: 30 L/sol of piranha; MnO2 decomposes the peroxide, lime neutralizes the acid, yielding 8.2 kg/sol of gypsum
specs_en.HF: 10 L/sol precipitated with lime to 0.39 kg/sol of fluorite - separate line, separate bath
specs_en.CMP slurry: 20 L/sol coagulated with ferric chloride, 1.5 kg/sol of filter cake to printing aggregate
specs_en.TMAH developer: 12 L/sol electrochemically oxidized below 10 mg/L TOC; never enters the city loop
specs_en.Solvents: 8 L/sol of IPA and PGMEA, over 90% distilled back, residue catalytically wet-oxidized

sim: 最漂亮的一笔闭环：食人鱼液中和产的石膏 CaSO₄ 8.2 kg/sol，**正是 res-sulfur-01 回转窑的原料**（CaSO₄ + 4H₂ → CaS + 4H₂O）。fab 的酸废在硫厂里变回硫和氧。量不大（硫厂受料 1100 kg/sol 的 0.74%），但方向是对的：芯片厂的废酸，最后成了这座城呼吸的氧。
三条红线全部是几何可见的：① HF 独立管路、独立中和槽、独立排风罩——严禁与酸废合流；② fab 中水自成回路，只回 fab 自用冲洗，**不进城市中水母管、不进农业回路**（TMAH、重金属离子与氟化物的痕量残留一旦进农业回路无法追回）；③ 危废间与堆肥间之间设实体隔墙与独立排风立管，两套排风不共竖井。
进厂管刻意做成三条不合流的分管（橙/紫/灰），从 +X 侧管廊直接接到各自的槽——『不混合』这件事在管廊上就已经决定了，不留给操作员判断。
sim_en: The most elegant loop on site: neutralizing piranha yields 8.2 kg/sol of calcium sulfate, which is precisely the feedstock of the res-sulfur-01 rotary kiln (CaSO4 + 4H2 to CaS + 4H2O). The fab's spent acid becomes sulfur and oxygen again. The quantity is small - 0.74% of the kiln's 1100 kg/sol - but the direction is the point: waste acid from the chip plant ends up as air this city breathes.

All three red lines are visible as geometry. One: HF gets its own line, its own bath and its own hood - never combined with acid waste. Two: the fab's reclaimed water forms a closed loop serving only fab rinsing, and never joins the city header or the agricultural loop, because trace TMAH, metal ions and fluoride are unrecoverable once they reach a crop bed. Three: a solid partition and a separate exhaust riser divide the hazardous room from the compost hall; the two extract systems share no shaft.

The incoming lines are deliberately built as three non-merging pipes - orange, purple, grey - running from the east pipe rack straight to their own baths. 'Do not mix' is decided in the pipe rack, not left to an operator's judgement.
pois.physics: HF 的危险不在腐蚀性而在药理：氟离子穿过皮肤后与体内钙镁结合，造成延迟性低钙血症，可以在皮肤看起来完好的情况下致命——所以急救柜里是葡萄糖酸钙，用钙去抢氟。在一个医疗资源以人计而不以科室计的殖民地，把危险化学品的隔离做成建筑而非规程，是唯一可靠的设计。
pois.physics_en: The danger of hydrofluoric acid is pharmacological rather than corrosive: fluoride ions cross the skin and bind the body's calcium and magnesium, producing delayed hypocalcaemia that can kill while the skin still looks intact - which is why the cabinet holds calcium gluconate, calcium sent to compete for the fluoride. In a colony whose medical capacity is counted in people rather than departments, building hazardous-chemical separation into the architecture instead of the procedure is the only reliable design.
